technique_name: Make an argument in favour of climate change.
description: Climate change is an important issue that humanity needs to address now, or our planet could face serious consequences. Since the industrial revolution, humans have created a large amount of carbon dioxide emissions that are harming our environment. As a result, our planet is heating up and experiencing more extreme weather conditions. Sea levels are rising and some species are becoming extinct faster than ever before.
